d:
The seventh installation from my Album ‘Navaras’ is streaming on all platforms!
Rishab in this song introduces a new age electronic Sitar: Rik-E-Sitar, which is an updated model of Zitar, originally designed by his father Sanjay Rikhiram. The song captures chaos, horror and anxiety in Raga Kirwani. The instrumentation of the track consists of the traditional sitar, tabla, strings, heavy 808s, synths, hard hitting drums, backed by a plethora of haunting voices.
